points.description: States that the table maps destinations/stations (MAC addresses) to outgoing LAN interfaces/ports, and that it is filled during backward learning by recording the source address of each received frame with the LAN it arrived on ("Q reachable via L", starting empty and learned by observing traffic). Equivalent wording accepted.

rubric.notes: The question is worth 1 mark in total. Full marks need the table content (MAC to interface mapping) and the learning step (source address of an incoming frame plus the arrival LAN is added). A student who gives only one of these earns no marks.
